description: Phase 1: Change of use and conversion of Observatory from mainly B1 office use to single C3 dwelling house with associated external/ internal alterations including new services/plant, relocation of Meteorological Huts /other historic remnants with curtilage; removal of majority of ancillary buildings/ structures/hard standing including C3 caretakers lodge. Conversion of part of ancillary B1 office to interim C3 staff cottage with external/internal alterations; interim retention of part car park; construction of lake with boathouse/ replace transformer/grounds man shed; realignment of existing access to road and regarding of artificial mounds, new landscaping and boundary treatment. Phase 2: Removal of interim C3 staff cottage, remaining surface car parking and section of observatory vault; construction of subterranean extension with underground link to provide ancillary accommodation for dwelling house and staff, separate staff flat and car park; associated re-grading/landscaping. (Refer to letter from Alistair Grills dated 2nd August 2011)
